test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Humble
solution: The correct answer is **"Assertive."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Humble"** means having a modest or low view of one's importance or achievements. (विनम्र, विनीत; घमंडी नहीं) • **Example:** *He always remained a **humble**__ man.* • **"Assertive"** means expressing your opinion clearly and firmly so that people listen to you or do what you want. (स्‍पष्‍ट और दृढ़ रीति से अपनी राय व्‍यक्त करते हुए, ताकि दूसरे उसे सुनें, समझें और करें) __ • **Example:** *If you really want the promotion, you'll have to be more **assertive**__.* • So, **"Assertive"** is the opposite of **"Humble."** • Therefore, the correct answer is** option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Votary"** means a person who is devoted to a particular cause or organization. (तरफ़दार) • **"Passive"** means accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance. (जो कोई प्रतिक्रिया, भावना या रुचि न दिखाए; निष्क्रिय) • **"Diffident" **means modest or shy because of a lack of self-confidence. (आत्‍मसंशयी, अपनी शक्ति या योग्‍यता में विश्‍वास न रखने वाला; आत्‍मविश्‍वासहीन) 1d0:T5f3, Here, the erroneous part is **"the two words that the judge use".**
